latest_final: The person was frying food in the hall’s pantry/cooking area. Airborne grease particles from the frying reached a nearby, unusually sensitive smoke detector and set off the alarm. There was no actual fire, and the food was not burned. An extractor fan or range hood was installed but was not operating, so it did not draw the particles away from the detector. The exact appliance and frying method are not established.
